officialEvidence.network: Stadtwerke Solingen states it operates about 80 charging stations / 160 charging points in the public and semi-public area of Solingen.
officialEvidence.pricingPolicy: Current AC/DC kWh costs must be read in the Stadtwerke Solingen Lade-App; the operator expressly states that the applicable price is location/operator-specific and is the price displayed before charging.
officialEvidence.registeredStartFee: Registered customers have the 0.49 EUR per-session start fee waived; no operator-wide kWh value is published on the current public page.

decision: Fail closed at station/EVSE scope. The current official service makes the pre-session app tariff authoritative and warns that prices can vary by location/operator. Do not infer a universal DE*SOL kWh price. Defer app/chargecloud enumeration until after the first pass across all 591 known CPOs.
